verdict.rationale: Smithery is an MCP registry, so published quality signals are a fair question for it. The evidence documents registry search, dedicated server pages and metadata scanning, but none of it describes usage counts, health or liveness checks, scores, or verification badges for comparing servers. A per-connection auth status and a third-party security scan of 'top' servers are adjacent at most and are not product-published quality signals.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compare servers using published quality signals — usage counts, health or liveness checks, scores, or verification badges
